item.title: Sources: Anthropic's IPO left 50%+ of bidding institutional investors with zero shares; allocations heavily favored US investors, shutting out foreign orders (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Sources: Anthropic's IPO left 50%+ of bidding institutional investors with zero shares; allocations heavily favored US investors, shutting out foreign orders  —  Anthropic PBC's initial public offering left more than half of the institutional investors bidding for stock without any shares, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX (Gerardo Fortuna/Politico)
item.description:
Gerardo Fortuna / Politico:
The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX  —  Presented by European Commission's Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture  —  with MAX GRIERA  —  CIAO THERE.

item.title: Google partners with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to launch TPU-powered AI server satellites aboard the New Glenn rocket in Q1 2029, as part of Project Suncatcher (Emma Roth/The Verge)
item.description:
Emma Roth / The Verge:
Google partners with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to launch TPU-powered AI server satellites aboard the New Glenn rocket in Q1 2029, as part of Project Suncatcher  —  It will be the first dedicated heavy lift launch for Google's Project Suncatcher. … Google is teaming up with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to launch its AI server satellites.
